info.title: ticketmaster-klon API
info.description: REST API of ticketmaster-klon, generated from the route table in `apps/api/src/openapi` and the Zod schemas of `packages/shared`. Unofficial, not affiliated with any ticket vendor. Behavior beyond the schemas is described in docs/api/rest.md.

401.description: The bearer token that was sent is invalid.
The bearer token that was sent is invalid.

503.description: Postgres or Redis does not answer.

get.summary: List public events and the caller’s own sandbox events

401.description: The bearer token that was sent is invalid.

post.summary: Create an event on a venue

400.description: A malformed body, or a `startsAt` that is not in the future.

403.description: The token carries none of the required roles.

get.summary: Read an event with its seats and their derived status

401.description: The bearer token that was sent is invalid.

404.description: Unknown event, or another user’s sandbox event.

get.summary: Stream the seat statuses of an event

200.description: Server-sent events: one `snapshot`, then one `change` per seat change; a `: heartbeat` comment every 15 s. The stream ends after 10 minutes, the client reconnects.

401.description: The bearer token that was sent is invalid.

404.description: Unknown event, or another user’s sandbox event. Answered as JSON before the stream starts.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded, or 10 streams are already open for the client address.

503.description: More than 500 streams are open in this process.

patch.summary: Switch the booking strategy of an event

200.description: The event with its new strategy.

403.description: The token carries none of the required roles.

404.description: Unknown event. A demo admin may switch only their own sandbox events, a regular admin only public events; any other event is 404.

403.description: The token carries none of the required roles.

404.description: The seat is not in the event, or the event is another user’s sandbox event.

200.description: Newest first, each with its stored transitions newest first.

403.description: The token carries none of the required roles.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A random UUID the client generates for each payment attempt and repeats only to retry that attempt.

200.description: CONFIRMED, or CANCELLED when the payment fails. The same key on the same booking returns the first answer without a second charge.

403.description: The booking belongs to another user.

409.description: The hold expired, the booking cannot be paid, or the key was used for another booking.

post.summary: Cancel a held or confirmed booking

403.description: The booking belongs to another user.

409.description: The booking is neither HELD nor CONFIRMED.

403.description: The token carries none of the required roles.

get.summary: List the events the caller owns, with sales numbers

403.description: The token carries none of the required roles.
The token carries none of the required roles.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (`SIMULATION`), or two runs are active (then without `Retry-After`).

200.description: The 20 latest FINISHED runs of the last hour, newest first.

403.description: The token carries none of the required roles.

401.description: The bearer token that was sent is invalid.

get.summary: Stream the progress of a run

200.description: Server-sent events: the progress at the start and whenever it changes; the stream completes after FINISHED or FAILED, or after 10 minutes.

401.description: The bearer token that was sent is invalid.

404.description: Unknown run. Answered as JSON before the stream starts.

503.description: More than 50 streams are open in this process.

post.summary: Create a temporary demo user and sign in

200.description: The tokens of the new user.

401.description: The bearer token that was sent is invalid.

503.description: The demo is full (200 demo users, nothing is created), or Keycloak does not answer within 5 s.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens

200.description: A new access and refresh token.

500.description: Keycloak answered in an unexpected way, for example a wrong client secret.

503.description: Keycloak fails (5xx) or does not answer within 5 s.

bearerAuth.description: An access token of the Keycloak realm. The roles listed in a route’s security requirement are alternatives: one of them is enough.

ValidationError.description: The paths of the invalid fields, never their values.
